    • getName

      public String getName()
      Returns the name of this entry: either a directory name or a file name. This does not contain any directory components -- strictly the name of this entry. Note that depending on context, this may be a computed field.
      Specified by:
      getName in interface FileEntry

    • setName

      public void setName(String name)
      Sets the name of this file. Uses the NAME_MAPPER to fix characters. This method only errors if, after applying the rules, the string is empty.

    • getProdosAttributes

      public ProdosAttributes getProdosAttributes()
      Interpret the FileEntry as if it were on a ProDOS volume. The intention is that ProDOS ended up being the common denominator in many tools and formats, so this allows each file store to manage the interpretation itself.
      Specified by:
